notes.title: v0.0.0.72: New Feature Update – Focus Timer & St. Patrick’s Day Event!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you're all doing well and enjoying the game! Today, I’m excited to introduce a new feature based on a player suggestion. A while ago, someone asked if I could add a Focus Timer to help them study while running Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat in the background. Well, it’s here!

You can now enable or disable the Focus Timer from the settings menu. If you have any feedback or suggestions for improvements, I’d love to hear them!

This update also brings St. Patrick’s Day limited-time event items! You can read more about the event here: Steam News.

I hope these updates make the game even better for you.

Happy playing!
Prateek / Destroyer Doggo

notes.title: Release Date for Bao Bao's Cozy Laundromat
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! It’s been a while since my last update here on Steam, but I’m excited to share something special with you today. Over the past few days, many of you have reached out, eagerly asking about the release date. Well, the wait is over—here it is!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185730/2f10675d36ee47aca21a87d692ae957f98ca31f8.png

📢 Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat launches on March 6, 2025! 🎉

If you're as excited as I am, I’d love your help in spreading the word! Share this announcement with your friends and on social media using #BaoBao. Every share helps bring more cozy vibes to the community! 💖

Thanks for your support—I can’t wait for you all to play! 🐼🧺
